picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission is a landmark national push to embed AI into scientific discovery, and UW researchers landing four awards within a 300+ institution program signals both federal commitment to AI-for-science and UW's growing role in that effort.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $10M grant (part of a $60M OpenAI Foundation investment) to deliver AI-powered weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a concrete example of AI research translating into large-scale humanitarian and economic impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: Rolling ChatGPT Edu out to over 80,000 students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, marking a significant industry-academia bet on AI literacy at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million gift establishing a dedicated College of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Analytics reflects growing private investment in building institutional AI capacity and workforce pipelines.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: Selection for a DOE-led national team on the 'Mine of the Future' shows AI research expanding into critical minerals and industrial infrastructure, a strategically important but less-covered application area.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claim to have solved a Millennium Prize math problem is a major scientific claim with real implications for AI's reasoning capabilities, though Terence Tao's public skepticism underscores that it needs independent scrutiny before being accepted.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology, achieving 100x density gains over existing approaches, is a genuine hardware advance that could reshape how AI is deployed on edge and embedded devices.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: InstructMesh's ability to let users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models addresses a real usability gap in generative design, moving AI-generated content closer to practical manufacturing use.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: An Australia-first pilot to make AI data center power loads dynamically grid-responsive tackles the increasingly urgent problem of AI's energy footprint, a rare infrastructure-level solution rather than just more compute.
picks.title: Australia-first pilot to transform data centres from static loads into dynamic grid aware assets

picks.editorial_note: Finding that AI models misread police bodycam footage in roughly 1 in 4 cases is a consequential accuracy finding directly relevant to ongoing policy debates over AI use in law enforcement and the justice system.
picks.title: AI tools can miss the mark on police bodycam footage
